class.name: RSTDocument
class.description: The editor imports UTF-8 [code].rst[/code] files as [RSTDocument] resources. The resource stores the source text and its original project path so relative images and downloads continue to resolve in exported projects. Relative document links and [code]:ref:[/code] targets are indexed from configured document roots.

method.name: get_reference_index
method.description: Returns the reference index used to resolve cross-document targets, or [code]null[/code] when none is assigned.

method.name: resolve_path
method.description: Resolves a resource path relative to this document's source directory. [code]uid://[/code] paths are resolved through [ResourceUID].

method.name: set_reference_index
method.description: Sets the reference index used to resolve cross-document targets.

members.member: The optional generated [RSTReferenceIndex] used to resolve cross-document [code]:ref:[/code] targets.
The original project path of the imported [code].rst[/code] file. It is used to resolve relative resource paths.
